title: Asiad: No gold for Eala as Pinay top seed falls to China's Wang in semis
summary: Filipina tennis star Alex Eala will miss out on a gold medal in the 2026 Asian Games after a shock loss to China's Wang Xiyu in the semifinals of the women's singles.
